notes.title: Update to 060.15 (Aug 12, 2024)
notes.notes:
It's been a while and I apologize. I've been working to support new tilesets.

[list]
[*] Support has been added for new tilesets. The first out is "Guardians". Select this from the Settings menu. There is free content.
[*] The POI note will respond to clicks on URLs and launch them in a browser. Just type the full URL like https://discord.com/channels/1199797815371649105/1199802861425541171 and you can click directly on that text in the POI to open it in a browser. This should be nice for linking to your D&D Beyond characters, etc.
[/list]

Have fun!

-Mispar

notes.title: UI Overhaual - Overworld version 060
notes.notes: Version 060 features a completely reworked UI and the implementation of Overlays! These are intended to display political factions or organizations.

notes.title: Update 058.9 - Beta Test Version! - Label Overhaul
notes.notes:
Alright, we are rolling out the beta test version! If you are interesting in testing please join our Discord: https://discord.gg/p2EtGF3kPs, Reddit r/MisparGames, or add hjulnum on Steam. Or simply reply and I'll reach out!

Here are the official changes to Overworld - Map Keeper's Realm

- Complete label overhaul
- Fixed generator tool hiding under certain circumstances
- Disabled creating multiple POIs on one hex
- Added ability to overlay images for translating paper maps into editor
- Fixed crashing when using identical terrains with the bucket
- Achievement bug fixes
- Fixed renaming worlds bug
- Fixed region tiles failing to properly cook to continent/world level
- Fixed undoing not pushing to bitmap

notes.title: Update 0.057
notes.notes:
- Removed selector tool, replaced with layering changes to POI and labels
- Zooming in to edit added to world level
- Complete overhaul of POI system
- Added NPC/MOB type to POIs

POI systems are completely overhauled with with 057! They are now much more smooth.
